limits: Historical validators are never executed. Only fixed read-only check/selftest commands and this runner's own .scratch fixtures run; no command is executed from an evidence file.
Filed rounds 8-17 and the round-16 civ map are compared with the declared baseline and must be byte-identical: this round's pins and revisions are NEW rows/files, never in-place edits of filed bytes.
The frozen-replay subprocess runs with TMPDIR outside the repository because tools/replay-frozen.py refuses an in-repo mirror root by design; nothing is written into the lane by that subprocess.

The round-11 generation's typed row is EXPECTED to read could-not-evaluate/gate_digest_mismatch once the gate is generalized: its recorded gate pin names the pre-generalization bytes, and the new pins live in the round-18 generation. The row's filed bytes are never edited.

Claim C is a map revision over the round-17 dispositions: a transitioned row's evidence pointer must resolve and carry a dated, command-carried receipt; the freshness axis-move remains paused and no source freshness verdict, re-grade, or rank change is issued.
D4 discovery is semantic (schema/filename) so a differently named artifact is still found; the canonical names are the D2 convention with a d4 suffix.
All artifacts measured are NON-CANON; this receipt does not certify truth, canon, lore receipt, cultural permission, or any real-world clearance.
